dedupe_keys.name: encrypted peertube and youtube video stream traffic measurements

description: This dataset captures encrypted network traffic during playback of deliberately selected PeerTube and YouTube videos. Researchers at the Czech Technical University in Prague and University of South Bohemia use traffic probes to study how transmitted volume varies over time and across content categories. PeerTube allows controlled streaming parameters, while YouTube represents a widely used delivery service. Zenodo offers the collection as a single ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage spans several months of experimental work, but exact dates and enclosed file formats were not established from the inspected repository metadata. Selected videos and playback conditions limit interpretation as a general Internet-demand sample. A reviewer-assessed use is checking streaming workload shapes and encrypted-traffic classification components in communications simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related network simulator, with no verified importer. The deposit describes network observations; no video content, traffic archive or identification model was downloaded or executed.
name: Encrypted PeerTube and YouTube video-stream traffic measurements
notes: G2-0256. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No dataset, model or article PDF downloaded; no program executed.
